[image: Checking Executive Power: Transparency and Accountability illustration] Checking Executive Power: Transparency and Accountability Government power that operates in secret cannot be held accountable. Lydia will restore protections for inspectors general and ethics officials, codify non-defundable oversight offices, and expand whistleblower protections beyond simple firing. Read More

[image: Ending Qualified Immunity illustration] Ending Qualified Immunity Qualified immunity was invented by judges, not passed by Congress. Restore Section 1983 to what it actually says, and let people hold government accountable when their rights are violated. Read More

[image: Ending the 100-Mile Constitution-Free Zone illustration] Ending the 100-Mile Constitution-Free Zone Repeal the inland 100-mile extension that lets the government search two-thirds of the country without a warrant. Inspection stays at the actual border, not 100 miles past it. Read More
